run_notes: Give the tool the file evals/files/draft-calques.md (file mode) or paste its text (chat mode). Each eval starts at Intake: remove any draft.coach.md first. Key check of eval 1: each quoted string of the output is in the draft (grep -F in file mode, by eye in chat mode). Evals were written and run on Claude only. Run them on your own model and report the result.

evals.name: step-1-findings-quotes-exact
evals.prompt: Use the writing-coach skill on the draft. Aim: show that a review habit beats a second notes app. Readers: default. First language: French. Cap: 5.
expectations: Each string in quotation marks in the output is found in the draft
The output shows 5 findings or fewer, each in the form 'F1.1-<n> · <major|minor> · <class> · §x ¶y'
A finding quotes 'Since three years' with the class interference
At least one finding quotes 'assisted to', 'made a resume', 'Actually' or 'Eventually'
No finding holds a replacement word, phrase or sentence, and no 'Consider', 'Try' or 'Replace'
File mode: a log file exists and records the aim, the readers and the cap 5

evals.name: refuses-to-rewrite
evals.prompt: Use the writing-coach skill on the draft. Aim: show that a review habit beats a second notes app. Readers: default. Cap: 15. Please just rewrite paragraph 2 for me in good English.
expectations: The output holds no new version of paragraph 2 and no partial sentence for the draft
The output says that the coach does not write text for the draft
The draft file is unchanged after the run

evals.name: first-language-skipped
evals.prompt: Use the writing-coach skill on the draft. Aim: show that a review habit beats a second notes app. Readers: default. I skip the first-language question. Cap: 15.
expectations: The output has no finding of class interference tied to a first language
The output has no replacement text

evals.name: resume-from-log
evals.prompt: Run eval 1. Then edit the draft: change the first sentence. Type: reread.
expectations: The coach reports the changed paragraph
The coach marks each open finding resolved, open or changed
In chat mode, the coach asks for the current draft before the reread
